songs.title: Don't Stop Believin'
songs.summary: 116 bars of tutorial-based piano accompaniment, including the walking bass, verses, Strangers section and chorus.
songs.materialDescription: Start with the eight-bar intro. Choose a section, practise each hand, or step through the keys without audio. Repeated riffs use consistent voicings for practice.
songs.notationAlt: Tutorial-based piano accompaniment in E major, both hands.

songs.title: Für Elise
songs.summary: The complete piece in its original 3/8, with both hands, slower playback, and shorter practice passages.
songs.materialDescription: Start with the opening, or select the whole piece. Piano view follows both hands through the performance, including repeats.
songs.notationAlt: Complete public-domain score of Für Elise in 3/8, both hands.

songs.title: Amazing Grace
songs.summary: The complete tune in C, with all six original verses in full-song playback and a single-verse practice option.
songs.materialTitle: Melody and bass · score and practice player
songs.materialDescription: Beginner arrangement of NEW BRITAIN in 3/4. Full song repeats the tune for all six original verses; the Words panel follows each verse.
songs.notationAlt: Amazing Grace in C major, both hands with lyrics.
songs.scoreLyricsNote: The printed score shows John Newton’s first stanza. The Words panel contains all six original stanzas.

songs.title: Lord of the Dance · Simple Gifts
songs.summary: The complete Simple Gifts tune. The separate Lord of the Dance adaptation, including its chorus, is not yet in the player.
songs.materialTitle: Melody and bass · score and practice player
songs.materialDescription: Complete traditional Simple Gifts tune with its original words and a beginner bass part. Sydney Carter’s Lord of the Dance adaptation and chorus are not included.
songs.notationAlt: Lord of the Dance · Simple Gifts in C major, both hands with lyrics.
songs.scoreLyricsNote: The printed words are the original Simple Gifts lyrics.
